purpose: Astronomical events expressed in A8 date, A8 time, and A8 celestial coordinates.
rules: Public event dates are A8 dates.
Public event times are A8 native times.
Sky positions use A8 celestial coordinates.
Reference stars use coordinates from the A8 celestial catalogue.
Calendar consumes event records; Calendar does not own astronomical event data.
Detailed astronomical explanation belongs to events.cosigo.io.
Legacy date, time, degree, or catalogue values are provenance or downstream comparison only.
No astronomical event is invented merely to fill the calendar.

catalog.scope: Primary public astronomical events suitable for A8 Calendar markers.
inclusionRules: Terra perihelion, aphelion, equinoxes and solstices.
Major annual meteor showers plus notable variable or fireball-producing streams.
Comets predicted near magnitude 10 or brighter, or comets with scientifically notable 2026 disruption or outburst behavior.
Major planetary oppositions, bright conjunctions and notable occultations.

precisionPolicy.DAY: Source establishes the event day but not a sufficiently precise public event instant.
precisionPolicy.WINDOW: Source supplies an approximate, rounded or bounded time. A8 time is derived but remains explicitly approximate.
precisionPolicy.PHASE17: Reserved for source evidence fine enough to identify one unique A8 day state.

generalSkyXY.y: A8 celestial latitude · 0 north pole → 128 equator → 256 south pole
generalSkyXY.engineeringDirection: Retain finer source-derived coordinates and permit deeper binary/octal fixed-point refinement without changing the public coordinate frame.
generalSkyXY.observerNote: General X/Y is celestial-sheet position, not local altitude/azimuth.
